title: The AVV conjecture on Ramanujan's gamma-function remainder
statement:
Let $\Gamma$ denote Euler's gamma function and define, for $x>0$, $G(x)$ and $H(x)$ by

$$
G(x)=\left(\frac{e}{x}\right)^x\frac{\Gamma(1+x)}{\sqrt{\pi}}.
$$

$$
H(x)=G(x)^6-8x^3-4x^2-x=\frac{\theta_x}{30}.
$$

**AVV conjecture.** The function $H$ is increasing from $(1,\infty)$ into $(1/100,1/30)$. This conjecture is attributed to the authors' earlier work and is motivated by Ramanujan's recorded approximation; its resolution is not given in the supplied text.
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2007–2010). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:0712.3856](https://arxiv.org/abs/0712.3856).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1006.5092

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2010).
source_name: G. D. Anderson and M. Vuorinen, “Reflections on Ramanujan's Mathematical Gems”, arXiv:1006.5092 (2010).
